title: Hypergeometric inequality conjecture for parameter $x$
statement:
For an integer $m$ in the range intended by the paper, let ${}_2F_1(a,b;c\mid z)$ denote the Gauss hypergeometric function. **Hypergeometric inequality conjecture.** The inequality

$$
{}_2F_1\left(\frac{3}{2},-m-2;-4m-4\mid 4x\right)-{}_2F_1\left(\frac{3}{2},-m-1;-4m\mid 4x\right)>3\left[{}_2F_1\left(\frac{1}{2},-m-2;-4m-4\mid 4x\right)-{}_2F_1\left(\frac{1}{2},-m-1;-4m\mid 4x\right)\right]
$$

holds for $x\geq\frac{1}{2}$.

The case $x=\frac{1}{2}$ follows from the monotonicity of the function $T(m)$ established in the paper. The assertion for all $x\geq\frac{1}{2}$ is the proposed extension and is not resolved in the supplied text.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1304.7872

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of April 2013).
source_name: Tewodros Amdeberhan, Atul Dixit, Xiao Guan, Lin Jiu and Victor H. Moll, “The unimodality of a polynomial coming from a rational integral. Back to the original proof”, arXiv:1304.7872 (2013).
